module_name: MD property spec + MD fixture helpers
purpose: Implement AttachA2Command_MD (the RISER command) and replace the awaitDeviceJoin stub with a real welcome-propagation poll. AttachA2Command_MD is the fc.AsyncCommand that authenticates the second device of identity A, waits for the MLS welcome to land (leaf count >= 2 on primaryPage), and sets m.membersA2 = true so subsequent S3/S4 commands can target device A2.

public_api.name: awaitDeviceJoin
public_api.signature: async function awaitDeviceJoin(pageNew: Page, primaryPage: Page, groupId: string): Promise<void>
public_api.description: Polls leafIndexesFor(primaryPage, groupId, pubkeyA) until length >= 2, with a 30-second timeout. pubkeyA is read from primaryPage via __notestrTestPubkey(). Throws on timeout so fast-check shrinks to the minimal failing chain. This is Option A (3-param) matching the seam contract in architecture.md.

public_api.name: AttachA2Command_MD
public_api.description: check(m) returns true only when m.membersA1 && m.groupId !== null && !m.membersA2. run(m, r) authenticates r.pageA2 with SLOT_A2, calls awaitDeviceJoin, sets m.membersA2 = true, captures initial epoch into m.epochSequenceA2, asserts leafIndexesFor(r.pageA1, m.groupId!, m.pubkeyA!).length >= 2. toString() returns 'A2.Attach()'.

dependencies_forbidden: e2e/fixtures/auth-helper-b.ts (not needed by awaitDeviceJoin or AttachA2Command_MD directly)
events_consumed: MLS welcome event — propagation observed by polling leafIndexesFor on primaryPage
signature_choice: Option A (3-param awaitDeviceJoin) — matches architecture.md seam contract and spec.md Technical Approach line 169. pubkeyA is read inside the helper via __notestrTestPubkey() on primaryPage. The S1 stub used 4 params (Option B); this story replaces it with the 3-param canonical form.
